title: T-Mobile is booting customers from its oldest plans
summary: Time to say goodbye to that legacy Sprint plan. | Image: Alex Castro / The Verge Earlier today, T-Mobile started notifying customers that it will be retiring many legacy plans and moving subscribers onto one of its current rate plans. Time to say goodbye to that legacy Sprint plan. | Image: Alex Castro / The Verge

Affected customers began sharing screenshots of the text on reddit and Threads this morning, and T-Mobile's chief marketing officer Allan Samson confirmed the news to The Verge :
